Facts: The prosecution alleges that from Aug 3 to Sep 27 2015, defendant Sun1 (孙1某) together with others formed a group that helps fraudsters (online) withdraw money. The scheme: online fraudsters get victims to transfer money into a bank account, then notify Sun1. Sun1 provides the bank card to his accomplices who go to the bank in Hainan to withdraw cash and hand it back to Sun1. They did this 13 times, defrauding victims for total 186,384.11 RMB. So Sun1 is facilitating the fraud by withdrawing cash. The question: what crime label fits? Likely "诈骗" (fraud) because they are part of the fraud scheme. However there is also "传授犯罪方法" (teaching crime methods) or "组织、领导传销活动"? Not. The group is helping fraudsters withdraw money, which is a form of "帮助诈骗" maybe "诈骗" covers the whole. In Chinese criminal law, there is crime of "帮助诈骗罪" (aiding and abetting fraud). The label list includes "诈骗". So likely the charge is 诈骗.

But also could be "传授犯罪方法" because they are teaching method of withdrawing money? The description: they formed a specialized group to help fraudsters withdraw money. That's more like "帮助诈骗" which is covered under "诈骗". The list does not have "帮助诈骗" separate. So answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>

Check if any other label needed: maybe "组织、领导传销活动"? No. "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫"? No. So single charge.
